doc: Per-frame update pass: refreshes all 16 D_80084960 entity slots by calling func_80056800/func_800568B4 on each, then for every D_80085458 slot with an active f06 field (< 0x10, count from D_80073734[0]) calls func_80056098, func_80055E84, func_80056654(slot, 0) to refresh it.
